_doc: W3-D exterior district compiler spec — a 360x280 bus-transfer plaza pocket inside D13's own subway/train-station bbox ((640,5120)-(4096,5632)); this pocket at (1600,5264) is verified clear of every existing d*.json solid stamp's true PNG footprint. Note: grp.subway.platform_bench_row and grp.subway.turnstile_gate both declare `surface: ground`, which placement-rules.json aliases to `grass` (not sidewalk) — so the concourse is landscaped lawn (a common real-world station-plaza treatment) rather than bare pavement, or the D_groups pass silently rejects every anchor as a surface mismatch (see EXTERIOR-MISTAKES.md pattern: a group's declared surface is a hard 80%-of-footprint gate, not a hint). Compile with: python3 scripts/compile-exterior-district.py --spec data/city-specs/biome-specs/transit.json --qa. Vocabulary (biome / surface / slot / role / density / palette / interact) comes from data/limezu-visual-catalog/placement-rules.json. Format: docs/EXTERIOR-COMPILER.md

compiler._doc: coords 'local': every rect/point below is relative to bbox (1600,5264), verified empty of every existing d*.json solid stamp's true PNG footprint — see EXTERIOR-MISTAKES.md #4 on stale bbox after relocate.

label: TRANSFER PLAZA

surfaces._doc: paved apron across the whole bbox for the bus bay and path_edge dressing

surfaces.name: concourse_lawn
surfaces._doc: landscaped plaza lawn — required so grp.subway.turnstile_gate and grp.subway.platform_bench_row (both declared surface 'ground' -> alias 'grass') pass the compiler's 80%-footprint surface gate; grass still allows street_furn/signage/infra per placement-rules.json roles_allowed

slots.name: bus_bay_edge
slots._doc: shelter benches and route signage along the paved bus-bay strip (explicit rect, not surface-derived, so it stays on the sidewalk apron and out of the lawn)

slots.name: concourse
slots._doc: the heart of the pocket: turnstile lane, wait seating, vending nook — matches biomes.transit density (infra/street_furn/signage all dense) as closely as the 'plaza' archetype's role list allows; infra is not a plaza role so furniture_ext (wait seats, benches) stands in for it

landmarks._doc: station stairwell descent, the pocket's hero silhouette
closed turnstile + railing + support pillar, 5x9 tiles (80x144px), anchored inside concourse_lawn well clear of the stairwell/tunnel

constraints._doc: a 360x280 pocket is ~23x18 = 414 cells; transit wants infra/street_furn/signage all dense, but the 'plaza' archetype does not admit an infra role (see slots.plaza.roles in placement-rules.json), so real headroom here is furniture_ext+street_furn+signage on ~255 concourse cells plus the bus_bay_edge strip. Target trimmed to 32 (from the beach pilot's 45) to match that catalog/archetype ceiling rather than chase a number by over-packing one role into repeats.
